title: Dissolving sugar
goal: Stir sugar into water until you can't see it. Find out what the scale shows then.
intro: Stir sugar into water and it vanishes from sight. Does it vanish from the scale too?

prediction.question: Once you can't see the sugar, everything on the scale…

safety: Never taste anything in a lab, even sugar water. Wipe up spills straight away so nobody slips.
